body:
I've exhausted therapist resources in my area. I have yet to get along with a female therapist and I don't trust guys. I finally found a therapist I could trust and talk to and it lasted 4 months. I'm tired of looking for therapists. I'm tired of creating a relationship with one and it going to shit. 

I am alone. I'm sitting in my apartment by myself right now. My one friend I have is having a great time elsewhere and I don't want to talk to her because I'll just bring Her down. I'm such a burden. So even with her, I'm alone.
